name: add_bento_order_item
title: 點餐
description: Orders one or more dishes on an open order for the signed-in member, all or nothing. Each item has menuItemId from the order's menu (get_bento_order), optionValueIds picking one value in every required group and at most one in a group that is not multiple, and quantity (1 to 10 lines). A bento admin may order for another member with userId. Confirm the dishes and options with the member first.

name: add_lab_meeting
title: 新增一週
description: Admins only. Adds one meeting on date; its week label comes from the semester (generate_semester). kind is regular (default), thesis, speaker or holiday; holiday says why there is no meeting.

name: add_mail_group_members
title: 加入群組信
description: Adds addresses (outside ones too) to a mailing list the member manages, as plain MEMBERs, at most 100 at once. Each address gets its own outcome: ok, already, denied, protected (not a member role) or error. Refused for gcp-* lists, lists outside the domain or nested in one.

name: add_paper
title: 新增論文
description: Admins only. Adds a paper presenters may choose: title, optional link, venue (e.g. NSDI'24) and tagIds from list_paper_tags.

name: add_paper_tag
title: 新增論文標籤
description: Admins only. Adds a tag papers can be filed under.

name: add_playlist
title: 加入歌單
description: Queue every song of a YouTube or YouTube Music playlist (link or id) at the end, at most 200. Songs already in the queue are skipped.

name: add_presenter
title: 加入報告順序
description: Admins only. Adds a member (id from list_members) to the end of their cohort in the presenter list; from then on they present in turn and ask questions.

name: add_reimburse_egress
title: 新增支出
description: Records money paid back to a member (reimburse admins only): applicantId (list_members), item, amount and invoiceDate; transferDate once the money is sent (null while owed) and the bank transferFee the lab paid on top. Confirm the entry with the member first.

name: add_reimburse_ingress
title: 新增收入
description: Records money coming into the lab fund (reimburse admins only): date, amount in whole NT$ and an optional note.

name: add_song
title: 點歌
description: Queue a song by YouTube video id. as=queue adds it at the end, as=next plays it after the current song, as=cut_in plays it now and puts the current song back at the front to resume later. Waiting recommendations (added_as auto) give way and are taken out. A song already in the queue is not added twice: queue leaves it where it is, next moves it to the front, cut_in plays it now.

name: book_meeting
title: 新增會議
description: Books a meeting as the member, 新增會議 on /meetings: a CS department room through the lab's shared account (the room /meetings would pick: open for the whole span, free before paid; a paid room only with allow_paid true, since the department charges for it), or no room with online_only. Every booking also gets a Teams meeting in the WinLab channel, recorded automatically with a transcript and an AI summary the channel can see, and every attendee and the member get a calendar invite by mail. Times are Asia/Taipei HH:MM on the 30-minute grid between 08:00 and 22:00; check list_room_availability first. attendees are portal user ids, emails or usernames; group is a project group's slug from list_project_groups, whose members are invited too unless invite_group_members is false, and which names the project the recording files under. epic (an iid from list_group_epics) needs a group linked to GitLab. include_advisor has no default because it mails the advisor. repeat weekly or biweekly makes it a standing meeting from date on instead (list_standing_meetings): each occurrence gets a room 7 days ahead, free first, else paid, so online_only is refused; epic may then only be a sync epic, and the answer is the standing meeting's id, how many occurrences were booked at once and why others were not. Never book the Monday lab meeting here; the portal books it itself. Read back the date, time, room or online, title, attendees, advisor and the recording, and get the member's yes first.

name: cancel_meeting
title: 取消會議
description: Cancels one of the member's own bookings (by id from list_meetings): releases the department room, takes down its Teams meeting and mails everyone the cancellation. Only the member who booked it; fails on someone else's or one already cancelled. teams_error is set when the Teams meeting could not be taken down: it will still start and record unless someone deletes it in Teams.

name: close_bento_order
title: 關單
description: Closes an order once it is sent to the restaurant (bento admins only): no more lines can be added, removed or copied.

name: copy_bento_order
title: 偷學
description: Copies another member's lines on an open order as the signed-in member's own, replacing whatever the member had ordered there. Prices and options are copied as they were ordered.

name: create_announcement
title: 發公告
description: Posts an announcement to the lab board, for portal admins only. notify=true also mails it to every current lab member (the Keycloak /lab-member groups, alumni left out), once; notify=false posts quietly. Mail cannot be recalled, so confirm the wording and whether to notify with the member first.

name: create_approve_document
title: 新增簽核文件
description: Starts a draft document for the member to send round: a title and the PDF as base64 (up to 10 MB). Fields are placed with set_approve_fields, then it is sent with submit_approve_document.

name: create_bento_order
title: 開單
description: Opens a lunch order to one active restaurant (bento admins only). date defaults to today in Taipei; a day may have several orders.

name: create_bento_restaurant
title: 新增餐廳
description: Adds a restaurant (bento admins only). Add its dishes after with set_bento_menu and its options with set_bento_option_groups.

name: create_door_phrase
title: 新增門口問候語
description: Adds one of your own phrases to what the door says when you open it, or with default true one of the lab's defaults (door admins). The door speaks it in CC's cloned voice once the voice job has made its clips, and in the stock voice until then.

after.description: Said after the name, e.g. "這麼晚來，很認真喔。"; may be empty.

before.description: Said before the name, e.g. "晚安，"; may be empty.

days.description: Weekdays the range starts on, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday.

default.description: true for one of the lab's default phrases (door admins only), false for your own.

ends_at.description: HH:MM, Asia/Taipei; at or before starts_at runs past midnight.

first_visit.description: Say it only on the member's first opening of the day (the day starts at 06:00 Asia/Taipei); first-visit phrases in force win over the others then.

name: create_leave
title: 請假
description: Signs the signed-in member up as away from one Monday lab meeting. date must be one of the next 8 Mondays (today counts if Monday), the same choices the page offers; one sign-up per member per Monday. The reason is shown to the whole lab, so confirm the date and wording with the member first.

name: create_trip
title: 新增出差
description: Opens a trip for uploads (trip admins only): a name such as 2026 ICRA 橫濱 and an optional description (dates, subsidy cap, notes).

name: delete_announcement
title: 刪除公告
description: Deletes an announcement from the board, for portal admins only. Mail already sent stays in members' inboxes; mail still queued is not sent.

name: delete_approve_document
title: 刪除簽核文件
description: Deletes one of the member's own documents that is not completed yet (a draft, or a pending one nobody needs to sign anymore). Completed documents stay.

name: delete_bento_order
title: 刪除訂單
description: Deletes an order with every line on it (bento admins only). It cannot be undone; confirm with the member first.

name: delete_bento_restaurant
title: 刪除餐廳
description: Deletes a restaurant with its menu (bento admins only). Refused once it has any order; switch it off with update_bento_restaurant instead.

name: delete_door_phrase
title: 刪除門口問候語
description: Deletes one of your own phrases, or with default true one of the lab's defaults (door admins).

default.description: true for one of the lab's default phrases (door admins only), false for your own.

name: delete_door_sound
title: 刪除門口音效
description: Deletes a sound from the door sound pool and from every playlist it is on. Only its uploader or a door admin may.

name: delete_door_voice_clip
title: 重錄門口語音
description: Deletes one voice clip, for example a badly pronounced name. The door speaks that text in the stock voice until the voice job makes it again, usually within a minute. Door admins only.

name: delete_lab_meeting
title: 刪除一週
description: Admins only. Removes the meeting on date with its questioners. Other weeks do not move.

name: delete_leave
title: 撤回請假
description: Withdraws the signed-in member's own sign-up for one Monday meeting, putting them back on the attending list. Only their own; fails when they have none on that date.

name: delete_paper
title: 刪除論文
description: Admins only. Removes a paper from the list. Fails while any week presents it.

name: delete_paper_tag
title: 刪除論文標籤
description: Admins only. Removes a tag and takes it off every paper; the papers stay.

name: delete_receipt
title: 刪除收據
description: Deletes a receipt and its file, for receipts admins only. The notice already mailed to accounting stays sent.

name: delete_reimburse_egress
title: 刪除支出
description: Deletes an egress entry (reimburse admins only). It cannot be undone; confirm with the member first.

name: delete_reimburse_ingress
title: 刪除收入
description: Deletes an ingress entry (reimburse admins only). It cannot be undone; confirm with the member first.

name: delete_standing_meeting
title: 刪除固定會議
description: Deletes one of the member's own standing meetings. Occurrences already booked stay booked; cancel them one by one with cancel_meeting.

name: delete_trip
title: 刪除出差
description: Deletes a trip with every file in it (trip admins only). It cannot be undone; confirm with the member first.

name: delete_trip_file
title: 刪除檔案
description: Deletes a trip file: the member's own while the trip is open, or anyone's at any time for a trip admin. It cannot be undone.

name: export_trip_files
title: 打包下載
description: A zip of a trip's files as base64, one folder per member (trip admins only); userId limits it to one member's files.

name: fill_presenters
title: 自動排報告人
description: Admins only. Fills every regular week from today on that has no presenter yet with presenters from the presenter list (list_presenters), in turn, starting after the last member already scheduled. Weeks someone already holds are left alone.

name: generate_semester
title: 產生學期排程
description: Admins only. Sets up a semester: start is its first week of classes, and weeks how many weeks of classes it has; every week's label is counted from them (第 1 週 to 第 <weeks> 週, 寒假 or 暑假 before and after); running it again for the same semester moves that start. Also adds one meeting a week, weeks rows from start, 7 days apart, skipping dates that already have one. Dates listed in holidays become holiday weeks with that reason. Presenters are not assigned; use fill_presenters after.

name: get_approve_document
title: 簽核文件內容
description: One document the member created or signs: title, status, creator, signers, and every field (page, box in fractions of the page from the top left, category, label, signer, the value once signed). to_fill lists the member's own empty fields, prefilled from what they entered last time; a signature is filled from the signature saved on their account.

name: get_approve_file
title: 簽核原始檔
description: The original PDF of a document the member created or signs, as base64 (without the filled-in fields).

name: get_bento_menu_image
title: 菜單照片
description: The photographed menu of one restaurant as base64 with its content type, or null when it has none. Use it when the typed menu is missing a dish.

name: get_bento_order
title: 訂單內容
description: One lunch order in full: the order (date, batch, status), its restaurant with the menu and option groups to order from, every line (id, member, dish, picked options, price), totals per member, and a tally per dish and option combination as the restaurant would take it.

name: get_bento_restaurant
title: 菜單
description: One restaurant with its menu: dishes (id, category heading, name, price in NT$) and option groups (甜度, 冰量, 加料, 不醬...; required means every dish needs one pick, multiple means several may be picked; priceDelta is added to the dish).

name: get_bento_stats
title: 便當統計
description: How much each member has ordered: dishes, NT$ spent and their most-ordered dish, over every order. A bento admin sees every member; anyone else sees only themselves.

name: get_door_sound
title: 試聽門口音效
description: One sound from the door sound pool as base64 with its content type and version (it changes when the file is replaced), to listen to it.

name: get_door_status
title: 門禁狀態
description: Whether the lab door relay is configured and answering, so open_door can work. Any member.

name: get_door_voice_clip
title: 試聽門口語音
description: One voice clip as base64 with its content type, to listen to it. Door admins only.

name: get_epic_deliverables
title: Epic 交付項目
description: What a meeting under this epic owes: the GitLab Deliverable labels (Presentation, Report, Code, Demo) on the epic's child issues, or on every issue of a report's iteration, with each issue's title and url. A sync epic owes nothing itself. group is the project group's slug, epic the epic's iid or reference.

name: get_mail_group
title: 群組信成員
description: One mailing list the member manages and its members as Google reports them (address, role OWNER/MANAGER/MEMBER, type USER/GROUP/CUSTOMER). Google's list is eventually consistent: a change may take a few seconds to show.

name: get_member_avatar
title: 成員頭像
description: One member's avatar as base64 WebP (size small 96px or large 256px) with its version, or null when they have none. Any signed-in member may look.

name: get_my_door_greeting
title: 我的門口歡迎
description: How the lab door greets the signed-in member: suffix (shown after their name on the LED panel, null for the default ！！), speak_name (whether the door says "Hi <given name>" before the sound) and their playlist, the pool sounds the door picks from at random (empty plays one of the lab's defaults).

name: get_my_signature
title: 我的簽名設定
description: Whether the signed-in member has saved a handwritten signature, whether it is drawn on documents they upload (stamp), and in which corner of the first page (tl, tr, bl, br). The image itself stays on the web.

name: get_next_lab_meeting
title: 下一場實驗室會議
description: The next Monday lab meeting that is not a holiday, from today in Taipei: date, presenter, paper or title, place, start time and questioners. null when nothing is scheduled.

name: get_profile
title: 我的資料
description: The signed-in member's lab account from Keycloak: Chinese name, English family and given names, account name, email and student id. Read only; members change these in Keycloak's account console.

name: get_receipt_file
title: 下載收據
description: One receipt's PDF as base64 with a filename made from its name, for receipts admins only.

name: get_reimburse_balance
title: 餘額
description: The lab fund's balance in whole NT$: money in minus money paid out (amounts plus bank fees), with totals and how much is still owed (egress with no transfer date). The owed amount is already subtracted from the balance. Reimburse admins only.

name: get_reimburse_stats
title: 記帳統計
description: The ledger summed up: money in and out (amounts plus fees) per month, and per applicant how many entries, the total paid back and what is still owed. Reimburse admins see everything; any other member gets only their own applicant row and no months.

name: get_trip
title: 出差內容
description: One trip with its files (id, filename, description, size in bytes, stamped when their handwritten signature was drawn on page 1, uploaded at): the signed-in member's own, or for a trip admin everyone's grouped by member. Use get_trip_file for a file's contents.

name: get_trip_file
title: 下載檔案
description: One trip file's PDF as base64 with its filename: the member's own, or anyone's for a trip admin.

name: get_trip_stats
title: 出差統計
description: Per member: how many trips they uploaded to, how many files and how many bytes. A trip admin sees every member; anyone else sees only themselves.

name: list_activity
title: 誰做了什麼
description: Recent actions, newest first: who added, cut in, skipped, removed, paused, resumed or changed the volume (a member's clicks within a minute show as the level they ended on), with the song title and, for playlists, how many songs.

name: list_announcements
title: 公告
description: Lab announcements, newest first, each with id, title, full content, author name, created_at, updated_at and mail: null when it was posted without mail, otherwise the mail's status (queued, sent or failed) and how many members it went to. Every member sees the same list.

name: list_approve_documents
title: 簽核文件
description: Documents the signed-in member created or must sign, newest first: id, title, status (draft, pending, completed), creator, each signer with signed_at, and to_sign true when the member still has to sign it. Only the member's own documents and ones they sign; nobody else's.

name: list_assets
title: 財產列表
description: Everything the lab keeps on NYCU's property system (assetweb) and still on the books, read live under the account that keeps it, the list /assets shows: kind property (財產, NT$10,000 or more) and kind nonconsumable (非消耗品, NT$6,000 to 10,000), two separate books. Each item has kind, id (財產編號) and no (財產分號), which together name one physical item within its kind, name, alias, brand, model, quantity, unit, cost and bookValue (NT$), acquiredOn (YYYY-MM-DD), usefulYears, keeper (保管人), user (使用人), location (存置地點, free text as the property office typed it) and note. Answers are up to 10 minutes old unless fresh is true. Only assets admins (and portal admins) may run it. configured false means the portal has no property account set.

fresh.description: true reads the property system again instead of the cache

name: list_bento_orders
title: 訂單
description: Lunch orders, newest first: id, date, batch (the nth order of that day, when a day has several), restaurant, status (open takes orders, closed has been sent), how many people and dishes, and the total in NT$. Every member sees every order. Filter by status; limit defaults to 30.

name: list_bento_restaurants
title: 餐廳
description: Restaurants the lab orders lunch from, pinned first, then by name: id, name, phone, map link, how many dishes, whether a menu photo exists. Switched-off restaurants are listed only for bento admins (active false). Use get_bento_restaurant for the menu.

name: list_cohorts
title: 入學年度名單
description: The lab's cohorts from Keycloak (/lab-member/114, 113, …), newest first, each with its current members' names and addresses (alumni left out), for adding a whole cohort to a mailing list. Managers of any list and portal admins only. null when Keycloak cannot be read in time.

name: list_door_events
title: 開門紀錄
description: Door openings, newest first, for door admins only: presses on /door (web), presses by an agent (mcp), calls to POST /api/door/open with a member's door token (api) and card swipes (card, timed by the reader's clock). ok is null for reader events that are neither a grant nor a known denial. Page back with before set to the id of the last event returned.

name: list_door_phrases
title: 門口問候語
description: What the door says when you open it, by the time of day: mine is your own phrases, defaults the lab's (door admins keep them). Each phrase says before + your name + after (e.g. "晚安，" name "這麼晚來，很認真喔。") from starts_at to ends_at (HH:MM, Asia/Taipei, past midnight when ends_at <= starts_at) on the listed weekdays (1 Monday to 7 Sunday, the day the range starts). At each opening the door picks at random one of your enabled phrases in force, else one of the enabled defaults in force, else says "Hi <name>". first_visit phrases are said only on a member's first opening of the day (from 06:00) and win over the others then. now lists the ids the door picks from for you right now; can_edit_defaults tells whether you may change the defaults.

name: list_door_sounds
title: 門口音效池
description: Every sound in the lab's door sound pool, newest first: label, uploader, whether it is a default (played for members with an empty playlist), whether it is on the signed-in member's playlist, and how many members have it on theirs. can_edit_all says whether the member is a door admin, who may rename, delete and mark defaults on any sound; uploaders may rename and delete their own.

name: list_door_voice_clips
title: 門口語音
description: The clips in CC's cloned voice that the door speaks greetings with, one per text ("晚安，", "詠翔，", "詠翔。"), and missing: the texts the door needs that have no clip yet, in the order the voice job on furnace makes them. job is that job: online when it asked within the last minute, text the one it is making now, step of steps done. Door admins only.

name: list_game_leaderboard
title: 遊戲排行榜
description: The top 20 members of one game on /games (2048, memory, typing, snake, pipes, queens), each by their best score (higher first, then faster finish_time_ms); level narrows typing (0 to 5), pipes and queens (1 to 100) to one level.

name: list_group_epics
title: 群組 Epic
description: The open GitLab epics of one project group (by its slug name from list_project_groups), most recently updated first: iid, title, description, url and kind. kind sync is a standing container (a series may only use these), meeting is one tracked meeting, report is a review over an iteration. Pass an iid as book_meeting's epic.

name: list_home_pins
title: 置頂服務
description: The services the signed-in member starred to the top of their portal home page, as service keys (bento, door, wiki and so on). Only their own.

name: list_lab_meeting_stats
title: 報告、提問與請假次數
description: How many times each member presented, asked questions and was away at the Monday lab meeting, each split into what already happened and what is scheduled from today in Taipei. A meetings admin gets every member with any record; anyone else gets only themselves.

name: list_lab_meetings
title: 實驗室會議排程
description: The Monday lab meeting schedule: for each week its date, label (the week counted from the semester's first week of classes: 第 3 週, or 寒假 / 暑假; null before the semester is set up), semester, kind, presenter, paper or title, slides and recording links, notes, place, start time and questioners. kind is regular (a member presents a paper from the list), thesis (a master's thesis talk, title written by the presenter), speaker (an invited talk, no member presents) or holiday (no meeting; holiday says why). past=false (default) gives today in Taipei onward, soonest first; past=true gives earlier weeks, latest first.

name: list_lab_members
title: 成員通訊錄
description: The lab's member directory from Keycloak: every enabled account except those Keycloak marks as not people (the /system group), current members and alumni. Each has id (Keycloak id), name (Chinese), name_en, username, email, phone, student_id, status (teacher, assistant, doctoral, master, undergrad, alumni or other), cohort (ROC admission year) and title (博三 for students, else the position Keycloak holds). status and cohort come from the /lab-member groups, falling back to the role and admissionYear attributes. Sorted by status, then cohort, then name.

name: list_leaves
title: 請假名單
description: Who is away from the Monday lab meetings, grouped by meeting date with each member's id, name and reason. Every member sees every sign-up. past=false (default) gives today in Taipei onward, soonest first; past=true gives earlier meetings, latest first.

name: list_mail_group_changes
title: 群組信變更
description: The latest 50 membership changes tried on a mailing list the member manages, newest first: who, which address, add or remove, and the outcome (refused tries included).

name: list_mail_group_managers
title: 群組信管理者
description: Who besides portal admins manages one mailing list: member id and name. Visible to the list's managers.

name: list_mail_groups
title: 群組信
description: The Google mailing lists the member may manage (/groups): every list in the domain for a portal admin, otherwise the ones assigned to them; each with its Directory id, address and name. status unconfigured when the portal has no Google credential.

name: list_meetings
title: 會議
description: Every meeting booked through the portal from date (default today, Asia/Taipei) for days days, the lab meeting's weekly Teams meeting included (lab_meeting_id set; its program is in list_lab_meetings): room (null for an online-only meeting), date, start and end, status booked or cancelled (cancelled rows stay), title, agenda, project group, attendees, who booked it, and the Teams meeting's state (pending, success with join_url, or failed with the reason). Every member sees every booking; only the member who booked one can cancel it with cancel_meeting.

name: list_my_door_cards
title: 我的門禁卡
description: The signed-in member's own door cards: the number with only its last 4 digits shown, the name on the reader, a note, when it was added, and whether it matched the reader at the last comparison (sync_state: synced, missing from the reader, unknown after an unconfirmed write, or deleting). Empty when no card is registered to them; a door admin adds cards.

name: list_my_door_events
title: 我的開門紀錄
description: The signed-in member's own door openings, newest first: presses on /door (web), by an agent (mcp), with one of their API keys (api, with the key's name) and swipes of their card (card, with its last 4 digits). ok is null for reader events that are neither a grant nor a known denial. Page back with before set to the id of the last event returned.

name: list_my_mail_groups
title: 我在的群組信
description: The Google mailing lists the signed-in member receives mail from, by their portal email (address): each list's address and name, and via: null when the address is a member itself, else the list the member is in directly that is nested in this one (up to 3 levels). status unconfigured when the portal has no Google credential.

name: list_paper_tags
title: 論文標籤
description: The tags papers are filed under (SDN, Kernel/eBPF, ...), with how many papers carry each. Use the ids to filter list_papers or to tag a paper.

name: list_papers
title: 論文清單
description: The papers a presenter may choose from: id, title, link, venue, tags, and every week that uses it (date, presenter, past true when already presented, false when chosen for an upcoming week). A regular week's paper must be one of these; pass its id to update_my_lab_meeting (the presenter) or update_lab_meeting (an admin). tagIds keeps only papers with any of those tags. presented=false leaves out papers already presented, true keeps them; left out, it follows showPresented, the member's own choice on the paper list (hidden by default).

name: list_played
title: 播過的歌
description: Songs that finished, were skipped or removed, newest first, with who added and who skipped or removed them.

name: list_presenters
title: 報告順序
description: The presenter list in turn order: doctoral students, then master's students, each by cohort (ROC admission year) and then by position. status and cohort come live from Keycloak; inRotation is false for anyone no longer a doctoral or master's student, who is skipped for presenting and asking. The same list supplies the questioners.

name: list_project_groups
title: 專案群組
description: The lab's project groups in Keycloak (/winlab-projects), each with its slug name (the Teams topic prefix and what book_meeting's group takes), a label, whether it is linked to a GitLab group (only then can a meeting belong to an epic), the members who can be invited, and the names of members with no email.

name: list_queue
title: 播放佇列
description: Songs waiting to play, in order, each with who added it and how (queue, next, cut_in). The playing song is not included; see now_playing.

name: list_receipts
title: 收據
description: Reimbursement receipts, for receipts admins only: pending (審核中) first, then approved (完成), newest first within each, with name, funding project, deposit account (post = 郵局, esun = 玉山), uploader and file size. Also returns every project used so far. status and project filter the list.

name: list_reimburse_entries
title: 帳本
description: The lab ledger, newest first. Egress is money paid back to a member (applicant, item, amount, invoice date, transfer date or null while still owed, bank fee); ingress is money coming in (date, amount, note). Amounts are whole NT$. Reimburse admins only. Filter with kind (egress, ingress or all) and pending=true for egress not yet transferred.

name: list_room_availability
title: 教室空檔
description: Free and busy time in the CS department's meeting rooms for up to 14 days from date (Asia/Taipei), read live from the department system, the grid 新增會議 on /meetings draws. Each run of the 30-minute grid lists the free-tier rooms open, the paid ones, and the rooms the lab's shared account already holds; lab_bookings says who booked those through the portal and what for. Every member gets the same answer. Book a slot with book_meeting.

merge.description: false returns every 30-minute slot instead of merged runs

name: list_standing_meetings
title: 固定會議
description: Every standing meeting on /meetings: title, weekday (0 Sunday), start time, duration, every week or every other week (anchorDate is a day it meets on, fixing which weeks), attendees, whether the advisor is invited, whether it is active, who made it, and its next occurrence with the room already held for it (booked false until the daily run books it, 7 days ahead). Every member sees every series; only its creator can pause or delete it.

name: list_trips
title: 出差
description: Business trips, open ones first then newest: id, name, description, status (open takes uploads, closed does not), how many files the signed-in member uploaded, and for trip admins how many people and files in all. Every member sees every trip; files are their own unless they are a trip admin.

name: load_gravatars
title: 載入成員的 Gravatar
description: Portal admins only: gives every member without an avatar their Gravatar, when their portal email has one. Members who uploaded a picture keep it. Returns how many were checked and loaded.

name: load_my_gravatar
title: 從 Gravatar 載入頭像
description: Replaces the signed-in member's avatar with the Gravatar of their portal email; fails when that email has no Gravatar.

name: move_presenter
title: 調整報告順序
description: Admins only. Moves a member one place up or down within their own status and cohort; the order between cohorts follows Keycloak and cannot be changed here.

name: now_playing
title: 正在播放
description: The song playing on the lab HomePod: title, artist, who added it and how (queue, next or cut_in), position in seconds, paused, volume (0-100), autoplay (recommend a song when the queue runs dry) and whether the player on the lab network is online.

name: open_door
title: 開門
description: Unlocks the lab door (EC 4F) for a few seconds, as the member pressing /door. It physically opens the door: call it only when the member asks to open it now. Any member; every attempt is logged under their name. A failure does not prove the door stayed shut.

name: play_next
title: 下一首播
description: Move a waiting song (by queue item id) to the front, so it plays right after the current one.

name: remove_bento_order_item
title: 刪除餐點
description: Removes one line from an open order: the member's own, or anyone's for a bento admin. lineId comes from get_bento_order.

name: remove_mail_group_member
title: 移出群組信
description: Removes one MEMBER address from a mailing list the member manages; owners and managers are never removed here. Same list rules as add_mail_group_members.

name: remove_member_avatar
title: 移除成員頭像
description: Portal admins only: removes one member's avatar (user_id from list_members).

name: remove_my_avatar
title: 移除我的頭像
description: Removes the signed-in member's avatar; their initial shows instead.

name: remove_presenter
title: 移出報告順序
description: Admins only. Takes a member off the presenter list, so they are no longer given weeks or questions. Weeks they already hold stay theirs.

name: remove_song
title: 移出佇列
description: Take a waiting song (by queue item id) out of the queue.

name: rename_approve_document
title: 改簽核標題
description: Renames one of the member's own draft documents.

name: rename_door_sound
title: 改門口音效名稱
description: Renames a sound in the door sound pool. Only its uploader or a door admin may.

name: rename_paper_tag
title: 重新命名論文標籤
description: Admins only. Renames a tag; papers keep it.

name: reopen_bento_order
title: 重開訂單
description: Opens a closed order again so members can change their lines (bento admins only).

name: replace_door_sound
title: 換門口音效的音檔
description: Replaces the audio file of a sound in the door sound pool with new base64 audio (same formats and 3 MB limit as upload_door_sound). The sound keeps its id, label, default mark and every playlist it is on, so every member who has it hears the new file from the next door open. Only its uploader or a door admin may.

name: search_music
title: 搜尋歌曲
description: Search YouTube Music for songs, or resolve a pasted YouTube / YouTube Music link. A song link returns that song; a playlist link returns the playlist (id, title, song count) and its first songs. Add results with add_song or add_playlist.

name: set_approve_fields
title: 設定簽核欄位
description: Replaces every field on one of the member's own drafts: each a box on a page (fractions of the page from the top left), its category (signature, contact_address, household_address, id_number, phone or other with a label) and the member who fills it (signerId from list_members). Signers follow from the fields.

name: set_autoplay
title: 自動推薦
description: Turn autoplay on or off for everyone. On, when nothing waits in the queue, music adds a song YouTube Music recommends after one a member picked recently (added_as auto). Skipping it works like any song.

name: set_bento_menu
title: 編輯菜單
description: Replaces a restaurant's whole dish list (bento admins only). Pass every dish that should remain: with its id to keep or change it, without an id to add it; dishes left out are removed. Past orders keep their own copy of names and prices.

name: set_bento_menu_image
title: 上傳菜單照片
description: Sets or removes a restaurant's menu photo (bento admins only). image is base64 of a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 4 MB; null removes it.

name: set_bento_option_groups
title: 編輯選項
description: Replaces a restaurant's option groups (bento admins only), in the order given: name (甜度, 冰量, 不醬), required (every dish needs a pick), multiple (several picks allowed), and values with a label and priceDelta in NT$. Past orders keep the labels they were ordered with.

name: set_door_playlist
title: 設定我的開門清單
description: Replaces the signed-in member's door playlist with these pool sounds (at most 50). The door plays one of them at random each time they come in, so a playlist of one always plays that sound; an empty playlist plays one of the lab's defaults. Use list_door_sounds for the ids.

name: set_door_sound_default
title: 設定預設門口音效
description: Marks a pool sound as one of the lab's defaults, played at random for members with an empty playlist, or unmarks it. Door admins only.

name: set_door_speak_name
title: 開門念名字
description: Sets whether the lab door says "Hi <given name>" before the signed-in member's door sound (speak true, the default) or plays only the sound (false). Self only.

name: set_door_suffix
title: 設定門口後綴
description: Sets what the door's LED panel shows after the signed-in member's name, at most 3 CJK characters or 6 ASCII characters; null or an empty string goes back to the default ！！.

name: set_home_pin
title: 置頂服務
description: Stars (pinned=true) or unstars (pinned=false) one service on the signed-in member's own portal home page; starred services show first, in a 置頂 group. Setting the state a service already has is a no-op.

name: set_my_avatar
title: 設定我的頭像
description: Sets the signed-in member's avatar from base64 png, jpg or webp (up to 5 MB). The portal crops it to a centred square and stores it again as WebP without EXIF; every signed-in lab member can see it.

name: set_paused
title: 暫停或繼續
description: Pause (paused=true) or resume (paused=false) the music on the lab HomePod. Resuming continues the song where it stopped.

name: set_questioners
title: 指定提問人
description: Admins only. Sets who asks questions on one week, up to 3 member ids. They become fixed picks the automatic assignment never moves; seats left empty are filled automatically. An empty list hands the whole week back to the automatic assignment.

name: set_show_presented_papers
title: 顯示報告過的論文
description: The signed-in member's own choice on the paper list: show=true also lists papers already presented, show=false (the default) hides them. It is what list_papers follows when called without presented.

name: set_signature_settings
title: 簽名設定
description: Sets whether the signed-in member's signature is drawn on page 1 of documents they upload (stamp) and the corner of the first page (tl, tr, bl, br). Leave out what stays the same.

name: set_standing_meeting_active
title: 暫停或恢復固定會議
description: Pauses (active false) or resumes (active true) one of the member's own standing meetings. A paused series books nothing new; occurrences already booked stay, and are cancelled with cancel_meeting. Resuming books, at the next daily run, every week within the coming 7 days that has no booking; to skip one week, keep it running and cancel that week's booking instead.

name: set_volume
title: 調音量
description: Set the lab HomePod's volume for the music, 0 to 100.

name: sign_approve_document
title: 簽核
description: Signs a pending document as the member: values fills their non-signature fields by field id (empty ones fall back to what they entered last time, see to_fill in get_approve_document); signature fields take the signature saved on their account, never an image from the caller. Fails while any of their fields stays empty. When the last signer signs, the creator is mailed.

name: skip_song
title: 跳過
description: Skip the playing song; the next waiting song starts. Pass the playing item's id so a late click cannot skip the song after it.

name: submit_approve_document
title: 送出簽核
description: Sends one of the member's own drafts round: every field must have a signer, and each signer is mailed a link to sign. It can no longer be edited after this.

name: swap_lab_meetings
title: 交換兩週
description: Admins only. Swaps who presents, and what, between two weeks of the same semester; dates, place and time stay. Holiday and speaker weeks cannot be swapped.

name: update_announcement
title: 編輯公告
description: Changes an announcement's title and content, for portal admins only. Never mails again, even when the post was mailed; members see the change on the board.

name: update_bento_restaurant
title: 修改餐廳
description: Changes a restaurant's name, phone or map link, pins it to the top (pinned), or switches it off (active false: no new orders, hidden from members; past orders stay). Bento admins only; leave out what stays the same.

name: update_door_phrase
title: 修改門口問候語
description: Replaces one of your own phrases, or with default true one of the lab's defaults (door admins); send every field back as list_door_phrases returns it, since a field left out goes back to its default. Set enabled false to pause it without deleting it.

after.description: Said after the name, e.g. "這麼晚來，很認真喔。"; may be empty.

before.description: Said before the name, e.g. "晚安，"; may be empty.

days.description: Weekdays the range starts on, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday.

default.description: true for one of the lab's default phrases (door admins only), false for your own.

ends_at.description: HH:MM, Asia/Taipei; at or before starts_at runs past midnight.

first_visit.description: Say it only on the member's first opening of the day (the day starts at 06:00 Asia/Taipei); first-visit phrases in force win over the others then.

name: update_lab_meeting
title: 編輯會議
description: Admins only. Changes any part of one week: moves it to newDate, changes its kind, holiday reason, presenterId (a member id, or null to open the week), paperId (from list_papers, regular weeks only), title (thesis and speaker weeks), slides and recording links, notes, location and startsAt (HH:MM). Leave a field out to keep it.

name: update_my_lab_meeting
title: 編輯我的報告
description: Changes the week the signed-in member presents (an admin may use it on any member's week): paperId from list_papers on a regular week, title on a thesis or speaker week, slides and recording links, notes. Leave a field out to keep it; an empty string clears a link or note.

name: update_paper
title: 編輯論文
description: Admins only. Changes a paper's title, link, venue or tags (tagIds replaces them); weeks presenting it show the change.

name: update_receipt
title: 修改收據
description: Changes a receipt's name, funding project, deposit account (post = 郵局, esun = 玉山) or status (pending = 審核中, approved = 完成), for receipts admins only; fields left out stay as they are. The file itself cannot change: delete and upload again.

name: update_reimburse_egress
title: 修改支出
description: Changes an egress entry (reimburse admins only); leave out what stays the same. Set transferDate when the money is sent, or null to mark it owed again.

name: update_reimburse_ingress
title: 修改收入
description: Changes an ingress entry (reimburse admins only); leave out what stays the same, and pass an empty note to clear it.

name: update_trip
title: 修改出差
description: Renames a trip, changes its description, or closes it (status closed: members can no longer upload, edit or delete) and reopens it (trip admins only). Leave out what stays the same.

name: update_trip_file
title: 修改說明
description: Changes the description of one of the signed-in member's own files while the trip is open; an empty one clears it.

name: upload_door_sound
title: 上傳門口音效
description: Adds a sound to the lab's door sound pool as base64 (mp3, m4a, aac, wav or ogg, up to 3 MB; the door plays its first 30 seconds) with a label, and puts it on the signed-in member's playlist. A member can have 50 sounds in the pool.

name: upload_receipt
title: 上傳收據
description: Uploads one receipt, for receipts admins only: a PDF or JPEG as base64 (a JPEG becomes a one-page PDF; convert PNGs to JPEG first), up to 10 MB. It starts as pending (審核中) and accounting is mailed a notice. depositAccount: post = 郵局, esun = 玉山; project is the funding project, reuse one from list_receipts. Ask the member for name, project and account when not given; never invent them.

name: upload_trip_file
title: 上傳檔案
description: Uploads one receipt to an open trip as the signed-in member: a PDF or JPEG as base64 (a JPEG becomes a one-page PDF; convert PNGs to JPEG first). Their saved handwritten signature is drawn on page 1 if they chose so. Up to 10 MB, with an optional description such as "3/14 飯店住宿".

name: whoami
title: 我是誰
description: The signed-in member: id, name (Chinese name from Keycloak), email and lab account username. Call it first to know who you act as.
